_comment: Worker <-> server contract. Read by server/ai-board/store.js and ai-board/worker.py; change here only.

execution_graph._why: The one graph the worker runs from intake to verdict. Read by ai-board/harness/runtime/exec_graph.py (LangGraph) and by the admin diagram; a node or edge exists only if the engine can take it. Pause (authorization) and resume are server states between the plan and execute entries.

repair_replan._why: Failure-class repair/replan. A repair round continues until a state hash repeats, repairs stagnate (limits.loop_guard) or no_progress_rounds rounds in a row show no progress (fewer failing tests, later gate, or changed diff); max_repairs is only the high safety cap; and a plan-class failure requeues one replan while the automatic round limit (2 plans) still allows it. Budget, lease, plan revision and ledger rules are unchanged; the same failure twice stops instead of looping.

root_work_scaling._why: Execute-phase root allowance grows with the approved plan's step count: base (root_work value) + per_step * steps, clamped to max. Plan-phase work has its own budget at the root_work base; hard caps never grow with progress. Read live from this file on every read/reserve: a redeploy raises the limits of existing roots (a stored limits_json can only raise, never lower).

limits._why: All AI Board caps in one place (feature-folders ticket 02). Per-run caps scale with the plan's subtask count n: base + per_subtask * n, clamped to max. Numbers are starting points; retune from the stratified eval (ticket 12).

units._why: GPU-s per run; a feature draft of 3-10 subtasks needs ~450-1600

wall_clock_s._why: each subtask may retry up to 4 times at 14B speed

model_calls._why: gate 1/2.5 calls + up to 4 attempts x (implement, repair) per subtask

local_wall_clock_s._why: Provider vllm/ollama: run time cap = base + node_wall_clock_s x subtasks, clamped to max; time (not tokens) bounds local runs, each node is already capped by node_wall_clock_s

loop._why: Tool-loop ceilings per subtask (runtime/tool_loop.py). AI_BOARD_LOOP_MODEL_CALLS / AI_BOARD_LOOP_TOOL_CALLS override for a measured run only.
loop.adaptive_why: Flag on: soft budget = soft_start + soft_step per progress signal (new read range, accepted edit, changed check state), capped at model_calls; stuck stops the subtask as blocked. Off = fixed caps above.

react_plan._why: Gate 2 ReAct planning loop (gates/react_plan.py). Read-only tools only; model_calls and tool_calls are per request. max_tokens caps one reply: a reply cut at the cap hands the plan back to the one-shot call instead of spending the rest of the loop. Flag off = one-shot plan as before.

brainstorm._why: One-shot plan call (gates/brainstorm.py): a reply cut at max_tokens is an invalid plan, so the cap only bounds the worst case; attempts stay at two.

gpu_wait._why: Model preflight failed (GPU busy): the worker waits backoff_s before probing the model again and doubles that wait up to max_s. No claim, no retry and no budget while waiting.

budget._why: Defaults of runtime/budget.py Budget (one run) and ChildBudget (one loop). BUDGET_MAX_<KEY> overrides for a measured run only. tokens count only for provider api (paid); vllm/ollama are bounded by time: node_wall_clock_s per graph node, wall_clock_s and units per run.

loop_guard._why: Native loop control replaces fixed step caps: a repeated state hash, a node over its time budget, or consecutive near-identical repairs end the walk with a named reason. Counts of model calls/repairs/plan bucket are recorded and shown, and only act as the high safety caps in root_work/budget. repair_replan.max_repairs (12) bounds repair rounds well inside execution_graph.recursion_limit.

progress._why: Progress-based loop control (runtime/progress.py): the loop slides a window over step signals instead of counting rounds. Signals and strategies are registries filled by the node that owns them; this block only holds the thresholds. Flags default off, so the old behaviour stays.

repair_agent._why: Last automatic layer before the admin, only for failure classes the deterministic ladder does not cover: one heavy-model call per attempt with the Gate 3 tool manifest, fenced context, schema and permission checks. Hard ceiling of attempts; flag defaults off.

behavior._why: Thresholds of the behaviour metrics shown per ticket (services/behavior.js). context_limit_tokens is the vLLM max_model_len; compression_ratio is compressed/original bytes, so a low value means repetitive output.

sandbox_client._why: Gate 5 runner client (verification/sandbox.py): per-call timeouts in seconds, retry attempts and backoff for transient errors.

sandbox_tool._why: run_in_sandbox tool-loop tool (runtime/sandbox_tool.py). Off unless flag=1. One VM per call; retries = new VM. argv must match an allowed pattern exactly; <test> = test/ path, <file> = repo path (path_policy). No shell. task_types: subtask task_type -> gates whose loop offers the tool; unknown or missing type = not offered.

global_rate._why: Trần toàn cục mọi phương án xử lý: request tạo mới và tin nhắn chat trong 60 giây, chặn spam trước khi ghi DB/đưa cho Claude. Đếm trên DB nên nhiều tiến trình vẫn đúng.

clarify._why: Requester clarification (contexts/ai-board-intake): the model decides when it is ready, so this is only the hard cap on questions. At the cap the summary must list assumptions so the requester confirms them. Daily model turns stay DAILY_TURNS=20 in the intake context.

retrieval._why: Closed-world retrieval grounding (LF/131): deterministic BM25 over stdlib, no GPU, no embeddings. bm25 ranks near files by path tokens; similar_exists decides when a verified 'similar function already exists' objection has a basis (an evidence file in the BM25 top over REPO DATA with at least min_score), otherwise it stays advisory.

pending_roots_per_user._why: owner 2026-10-28: miễn cap cho người dùng thường — đủ lớp chặn phía sau (global_rate, gpu_s_per_user_day, intake/language/gibberish guards), giá trị lớn chỉ để chặn tràn DB

open_folders_per_user._why: feature folders not yet archived; keeps branches and context bounded

folder_archive_days._why: a folder with no activity this long is archived: its cycle closes, history and brief stay

skills._why: Skill selection node (ai-board/harness/services/skill_selection.py). Counts every counted skill per prompt, platform baseline included; token bound is the UTF-8 upper bound of the rendered text. stages overrides per node (plan=gate1, execute=gate3, verdict=gate4_review); an undeclared node uses the global values. Intake runs in the server context without skill selection, so it has no stage here.

selection_node._why: One deterministic selection per role (services/skill_plan.py) with a pin over the chosen skills and the contract. Off keeps today's per-call selection byte-identical.

context._why: Feature-folder context tiers (ticket 06), chars. L1 brief, L4 decisions (ai_folder_decisions) and L3 recent requests are computed from the DB at read time; L2 owned-file outlines come from git. Full history never enters a prompt.

gpu_s_per_user_day._why: rolling 24h; over it the request waits, a running run is never cut

gpu_s_per_worker_hour._why: must exceed one max run (2400) so big tasks are not starved

attachments._why: Request attachments (ticket 87). Flag AI_BOARD_MULTIMODAL off by default; text cut at max_chars total, cut shown to requester.

memory._why: Worker-local files under ai-board/memory/ (gitignored). Everything there is a rebuildable cache except lessons; the worker prunes at start. Folder memory lives in the DB, not here. With a second worker, lessons move to a server table.

self_improve._why: Nightly self-improvement loop (.scratch/ai-board-self-improve spec). Off until an admin turns it on; never starts below min_labelled_tasks. Labelled eval tasks split by time: oldest learning_split to learn from, the rest to test on.

runner_busy._why: Gate 5 hoặc run_in_sandbox nhận 429 (runner bận) sau retry: worker trả lease, ticket về hàng đợi sau retry_after_ms, không tính retry và không chặn.

transient_retry._why: Yêu cầu (mọi loại, không riêng self) bị chặn ở cổng 5 vì lỗi hạ tầng thoáng qua (GPU dùng chung quá tải) sau khi backoff gọi model (main.py MODEL_RETRY_BACKOFF_S) đã hết mà vẫn hỏng. Mặc định tắt: admin tự xem Grafana rồi bấm 'Chạy lại ngay' lúc rảnh GPU. Bật: ticket tự về hàng đợi sau retry_after_ms, không cần admin theo dõi liên tục.

clock._why: Hiển thị giờ AI Board. DB giữ epoch ms tuyệt đối; chỉ format đổi theo múi giờ này.

evidence_gates._why: Keys for LF/123-128 gates. Inert until the gate that reads them lands; defaults keep today's behaviour.
